Text:
# Antibiotic Prophylaxis Transrectal Ultrasound Prostate Biopsy Procedures (TRUSP)

The recommendations for prophylaxis for TRUSP procedures have been updated based based on emergence of resistant E-coli bacteria strains.

---

References:

- Becopoulos T et al  J Chemother 1990 2:244-246
- Charalabopoolos et al Chemotherapy 2003 49:269-279
- Nam R et al J Urol 2010 183:963-969
Therapy:
## Preferred:

## Outpatient Prescriptions for Mailing:

Ciprofloxacin 500 mg po once ($) R,DI < AND >

Cefuroxime 1000 mg po once ($) [M], BOTH 2 to 3 hours before scheduled prostate biopsy.

## Outpatient Prescriptions for Window Pick-up:

Ciprofloxacin 500 mg po once ($) R,DI < AND >

Cefuroxime 1000 mg po once ($) [M], BOTH 2 to 3 hours before scheduled prostate biopsy.

## Alternative for patients who have not taken the oral medications:

## Administer in clinic on the day of procedure.

## Patients weighing less than 300lbs:

Ciprofloxacin 500 mg po once ($) R,DI < AND > Ceftriaxone 500 mg

Intramuscularly once ($) [M] BOTH given 1 hour before the procedure.

## Patients weighing 300lbs or greater:

Ciprofloxacin 500 mg po once ($) R,DI < AND > Ceftriaxone 1 gram

Intramuscularly once ($) [M] BOTH given 1 hour before the procedure.

## Alternative for patients with anaphylactic or other serious beta-lactam allergy

## Administer in clinic on the day of procedure.

Ciprofloxacin 500 mg po once ($) R,DI < AND > Aztreonam 1 gm intramuscularly
once ($$$$) [R] BOTH given 1 hour before the procedure.
